record.question: In ABC Hospital there were 100 deliveries in October 2025 of this 3 were by caesarean section. Find the caesarean section rate for October.
record.explanation: Answer C: 3. Caesarean rate = 3 caesarean deliveries ÷ 100 total deliveries × 100 = 3%. The options omit the percent sign, so numeric option 3 is correct. Reference: https://www.who.int/data/data-collection-tools/score/tools/hospital-statistics. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
